original_answer: Tanishq is owned by Titan Company Limited, and its beginnings under Titan date to 1994. However, 1996 is the better-supported year for its launch as a jewellery brand. Titan’s official sources disagree on the launch date: its franchising page says 1994, while its heritage timeline and an earnings-call transcript say 1996.
